question: A is three times as efficient as a worker than B, which allows A to complete a job in 60 days less than B. If they work together, they can finish the job in:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Efficiency ratio of A : B = 3 : 1, so Time ratio A : B = 1 : 3.

Difference in time ratio = 3 − 1 = 2 units.

2 units = 60 days ⇒ 1 unit = 30 days (A's time) and 3 units = 90 days (B's time).

Time taken together = (30 × 90) ÷ (30 + 90) = 2700 ÷ 120 = 22.5 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 22.5 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A is 3 times as efficient as B.

A completes the job in 60 days less than B.

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let time taken by A be x days and by B be 3x days.

⇒ Difference in time = 3x − x = 2x = 60 days

⇒ x = 30 days (Time taken by A)

⇒ 3x = 90 days (Time taken by B)

⇒ Total efficiency of A and B = 3 + 1 = 4 units/day

⇒ Time taken by A and B together = Total Work ÷ Total Efficiency

⇒ Time taken = 90 ÷ 4 = 22.5 days

**∴ The correct answer is 22.5 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency and Time Relationship

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time. If efficiency ratio of A and B is x:y, then the time taken ratio will be y:x.

Work and Wages

Wages are distributed in the direct ratio of the amount of work done by each person. If they work for the same number of days, wages are distributed in the ratio of their efficiencies.

Pipes & Cisterns

The concept of pipes filling or emptying a tank is identical to Time and Work. An inlet pipe has positive efficiency while an outlet pipe has negative efficiency.
